title: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict which PHP functions a shortcode's filter…
description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin versions before 7.9.1 allow users with Contributor roles to exploit a vulnerability where the filter attribute of a shortcode can call unrestricted PHP functions. This flaw enables attackers to bypass WordPress term-slug sanitization and conduct SQL injection attacks via another shortcode's taxonomy term attribute.
